Host processes / systemd; existing NetClaw installation
Host worker; separate state, credentials and scoped tools
Convergence is inline; no legacy iframe
Device exporters / APIs / logs / reachability probes
OTel: switch SNMP + device syslog TCP/UDP :1514
OTel fans metrics to Prometheus / VictoriaMetrics
Health / Wi-Fi / devices / alerts / diary / triage
Case identity: site + event_id + alert fingerprint
No LLM runs here; telemetry and case persistence
Enrich from Nautobot / inventory + RAG prior cases
Create / update initial case; send received notice
Default T0: record / notify; no LLM investigation
Concurrency 2 applies to receiver trigger handling
Suppressed / over budget → diary; no backlog queue
main + alert share the Border OAuth credential store
n2n-mcp is the Gateway’s tool-facing client
Python iN2N worker; persistent Border connection
Own OAuth store / sessions / member environment
Read evidence; compare prior cases; assess cause
Investigation procedure: report, do not auto-remediate
PATCH original case → resolved or escalated
Return task findings to the Border
Discord findings via configured notification path
Same account allowance; separate Border / Guardian OAuth stores
Subscription inference; no general OpenAI API key required
Model calls are outbound; no network device changes implied
Need More uses /reinvestigate → /hooks/alert directly; automatic admission gates are not reapplied on that path.
Ports are host bindings unless marked internal/container. Dashed = query / feedback; dotted = model/control. Crossings are not junctions.
Spawn model run per delegated task
